any tap or key → unlock() (plays a silent WAV blob)

next item preloaded on a second element)

setRate(1.5) → applies to current item immediately
and to every following item (persisted in localStorage)
Two tabs or devices: only connections open on this channel are
candidates. The first one claims automatically; a tab claims again
when it gains focus. The server sends playback.claimed {connection_id}
to all of the user's connections on the channel: the named one plays,
the others stay silent and show "Play here". When the player closes,
playback.claimed {connection_id: null} lets the focused tab take over.
